title: The Odyssey review – Nolan goes god-tier with breathtaking epic of men, monsters and moral metamorphosis | Movies | The Guardian
quote: This is a film with thrilling ambition, boldness, seriousness, generosity and flair. There are some broad-brush moments in the dialogue, yes, but even these are applied with a muscular flourish.

title: The Odyssey review: Christopher Nolan has done it again
quote: Technically, as you’d expect from this director, the movie is mightily impressive, for its scale, the graceful way it moves from one time period to another, and for the tactility of its imagery.

title: The Odyssey review — 'A monumental piece of work'
quote: Filmmaking at a magnitude few modern directors could ever realistically imagine, demand, or execute.

title: ‘Castle’ nothing to howl about movie review
quote: While the movie contains delights and inventions without pause and has undeniable charm, while it is always wonderful to watch, while it has the Miyazaki visual wonderment, it’s a disappointment, compared to his recent work.

title: Howl's Moving Castle | Culture | The Guardian
quote: Howl's Moving Castle has worked its charm on me as well: a floatingly delightful fairytale with its heart set on repealing the law of gravity.

title: Howl’s Moving Castle Review | Movie - Empire
quote: Fortunately, Howl is as much of a hand-drawn treat as Spirited Away, chock-full of numinous sunsets, fabulous organic machinery and gratuitously delightful touches.

title: Princess Mononoke movie review
quote: Hayao Miyazaki is a great animator, and his “Princess Mononoke” is a great film. Do not allow conventional thoughts about animation to prevent you from seeing it.

title: Princess Mononoke review – fervently inventive and imagined legend from Studio Ghibli | Movies | The Guardian
quote: I must admit to being agnostic about the animation: particularly the humans’ saucer-eyed moppet faces: but the story has simplicity and force, with captivating images and gutsy narrative ideas recalling Kipling, Ovid and Homer.

title: Princess Mononoke Review – 'Imaginative and intriguing'
quote: Often breathtaking in its imagination and sheer scale, notable treats include monsters with writhing, snake-like skins, mythical animal gods and, best of all, tiny forest sprites which are at once eerily creepy and unashamedly cute.

title: 'A Silent Voice' review
quote: Where director Yamada excels is in depicting the interior worlds of the two main characters, paying particular attention to details, whether visual or sonic, that seem to place a constant divide between Shoya and Shoko.

title: 'A Silent Voice' Review: Koe no katachi
quote: The film’s unflinching depiction of teenagers’ covert cruelty culminates in a riveting turning point when Shoya realizes that whatever goes around comes around.

title: A Silent Voice - The Movie | Under the Radar | Music Blog for the Indie Music Magazine
quote: Beguiling in its sadness and sentimentality, firmly respectful of its subjects, and absolutely effective with its numerous complimentary themes, A Silent Voice is one of the most moving films ever put to animation.

title: Neon Genesis Evangelion: The End of Evangelion - Review - Anime News Network
quote: Asuka's battle against the Mass Production Units is the only traditional mecha battle in this film, and also the most technically impressive and dramatically exhilarating spectacle in the entire series.

title: The End of Evangelion Review
quote: The grand finale combines heavily religious symbolism with freely associative imagery, coalescing in a perplexing, wholly engaging experience.

title: End of Evangelion DVD - Review - Anime News Network
quote: Though much of the imagery is grotesque, the whole film is an opulent wonder to behold, possessing a kind of horrific beauty. The end of the world never looked so good.

title: Grave of the Fireflies movie review
quote: “Grave of the Fireflies” is an emotional experience so powerful that it forces a rethinking of animation.

title: Grave of the Fireflies – review | Animation in film | The Guardian
quote: If you thought Bambi or Up were as emotional as animation gets, you need to see this Japanese masterpiece. It's a war story as wrenching as any live-action movie, and it has reduced many a viewer to tears – this one included.

title: Grave Of The Fireflies Review | Movie - Empire
quote: A devastating heart-stab of a movie, this certainly isn't a family film. It is, however, a beautifully constructed, animated drama.
